title: Add offline operation and pinned snapshot drills
purpose: Prove AgentOS can operate and explain ecosystem state from pinned local registry snapshots without network.
scope: Run ecosystem replay in offline mode.
Verify search/show/stage behavior without remote registry.
Verify degraded projection when snapshot is expired.
acceptance_criteria: Offline replay passes with pinned snapshot.
Expired snapshot produces explainable degraded state.
No network is required for baseline.
failure_modes: Offline mode hides blocked ecosystem actions.
